title: Does every task need a giant?
chapter: Does every task need a giant?
lines: Why ask one giant language model to interpret a request, calculate precisely, and authorize its own actions?
S*LM proposes dividing AI work among large models, small specialists, exact software, and people with clear responsibilities.

title: Intelligence by division of labour
